categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests', but changes unit test fixture construction in multisig_tests rather than test machinery or shared utilities.
categories.rationale: The test infrastructure category covers the machinery of testing (framework, runner, utilities, linters) rather than tests of a particular area. Modifying input and output construction in `multisig_tests` touches area-specific unit tests rather than test framework or tooling.
